release.name: v1.0.3
release.body:
Follow-up to v1.0.2: polish the release → draft path and ship the end-to-end demo.

### Changes
- Demo walkthrough: GitHub webhook → HMAC → claim → tier → LLM → draft → approval PR
- Idempotent delivery handling on retries
- Schema-locked LinkedIn/X drafts (never auto-publish)
